rapport_notes: Cordial and thorough but the pricing explanation ran very long with heavy monologuing (move-only, full-pack, and partial-pack quotes all stacked in one breath).
process_discipline_notes: Several monologuing flags during the price walkthrough, though not a scored repeat/silence violation.
top_strength: Explicitly asked for the close - "would you like to proceed on securing your truck on the thirtieth? We do not require any deposit" - even though the customer wanted to compare quotes first.
coaching_note: Three separate price scenarios (move-only, full pack, partial pack) were dumped on the customer back to back with no differentiators covered at all - none of damage coverage, meet-your-mover, or on-time guarantee were mentioned anywhere in the call.
